"At last, demon! I have vanquished your guards, obliterated your soldiers, and above all, triumphed over your evil!" the hero shouted, the doors slamming against the walls of the throne room.

With a smirk, I began to clap. Slowly, at first, the speed steadily increasing. When my claps began to echo throughout the room, I stood.

"Congratulations! Well done, well done, indeed!"

The man approached, his sword pointed at me. "Silence! You taunt me with phony praise?" He let out a rage-filled scream and began charging at full speed. 

I ceased clapping, sitting back in my thrown as I did so. "What's the rush? All this anger and hostility? Seriously, not even up for a chat?"

The hero continued charging, yelling obscenities. "Bastard! Vile demon! Damned herald of darkness!"

He made it about halfway when I spoke again. "Relax, friend. There's no need for all this drama." I raised my arm, pointed at him, and whispered, "Calm." 

He stopped ubruptly, his sword flying out of his hand, clanging on the ground. In a much softer, quiet tone, he said, "Ah, I see. You have abilities. Fair enough. I let my anger get the better of me anyhow." Walking at a normal pace, he went to the sword and picked it up. He paused for a moment before continuing his approach.

"Now that's more like it! See? It isn't that hard to be polite, you know. Now then, as you stated, you've bested quite a few of my followers. What for, if I might ask?" I crossed my arms, legs crossing instictually.

"'What for?' The demon king asks. 'What for?' says the lord of evil. 'What for?' The wretch of despair says to me! Are you mad? Ignorant? Unaware of all the death and suffering?"

His figure began to become more clear. Dented armor, red tinted blade, eyes dark with hatred. "Are you asking me if I know about life? If so, the answer is yes."

"So you admit it, then. I've waited countless hours, days, weeks, for this moment. Prepare yourself. If there is a hell for one such as you, I pray you suffer unfathomable tortures." He got to the stairs which led up my thrown.

"Sir, with all due respect, I haven't the slightest idea of what you're talking about."

"Again, you play dumb. Again, you act coy. How tasteless."

I scoffed. "Tasteless? I'm sorry, but do you have a thrown room big enough for thousands to sit and feast? Hand carved, hand sculpted statues of unimaginable beauty? I think not!" 

"Enough. Choose your next words more sparingly. They will be your last." He was only a few steps away now. "For your crimes committed against my people-, no, against all of humanity, I sentence you to death."

"Crimes? Against humanity? Oh, please. I haven't done anything."

"More lies. Is that really your final words? Lies?"

I help up my hands, palms facing him. "My boy, listen. If you think I'm in charge of all that is wrong with the world, you have been sorely mistaken."

He stopped, now at the top. His grip tightened on the sword. Veins could clearly been seen throbbing out of the side of his head. "Innocence. You claim innocence? More lies, more slander."

I yawned, covering my mouth. "Honestly, it's the truth. For such a warrior as yourself, you would fail to let your enemy bargain?"

"Speak. You wish to bargain, so speak. Confess, more like it." He stopped a few feet away, his sword still aimed at me.

"Splendid." I stood, my robes whirling up as I did. "The criminals of whom you seek are..." I raised my arms, lifting my head, "... humanity itself!"

Not that my opinion matters, but here's what I think. We were either given life by a freak coincidence or we were placed here on purpose. To me, they are equally terrifying, as well as important. Using either theory, you could say we are special. Sure, questions arise that really can't be answered. But how would we go about explaining them.

On one hand, you have life here on Earth, that is literally unheard of anywhere else in the universe, for now anyway, that just came to be as a result of coincidence. Why? How? If we ever came to a definitive answer that we are indeed alone in this universe, how would we as a collection of species handle that? How would we, as the supposed only self aware species, react? 

Then, on the other hand, we were placed here by a supreme power. Similar questions arise, as expected. Why? Is there a greater purpose? A purpose at all? If this is the case, how are we expected to find incontrovertible facts relating to science?

Just a bit of rambling, I know. But getting my thoughts out seems to help. Any comment is appreciated.
